title: Waterlogging at Daraganj Low-Lying Riverbank
description: Rising water levels along the lower ghat steps after upstream discharge. Local community reported ankle to knee-deep inundation near access lanes.
verification_notes: Ground inspection confirmed water encroachment on low riverbank paths. Temporary riverside stalls advised to relocate.

title: Fallen Tree and Damaged Power Line on MG Marg
description: High velocity gusts caused a large neem tree to fall across Mahatma Gandhi Marg, blocking the eastbound lane.
verification_notes: Feeder isolated to prevent electrocution hazards. Tree clearing crew dispatched.

title: Unconfirmed Report: Rapid Surge Near Phaphamau Ghat
description: Citizen post claiming river bank erosion and fast water flow near Phaphamau old pontoon staging area. Requires ground reconnaissance.
verification_notes: Pending physical check by flood post team. Drone survey requested.

title: Electrical Short Circuit at Commercial Godown
description: Dense smoke observed from an electronics warehouse attic in Katra market. Fire tender sirens heard arriving.
verification_notes: 2 fire units on scene. Surrounding shops cordoned off as a safety precaution.

title: Gomti Riverfront Promenade Inundation Warning
description: Water overflowing onto the lower walkway terrace near the Gomti Barrage. Silt and debris accumulating along the embankment.
verification_notes: Lower walkway barricaded. Sluice gate operation monitored.

title: Transformer Spark Fire near Commercial Plaza
description: Overheated distribution transformer ignited localized spark blaze behind retail arcade on Mahatma Gandhi Marg.

title: Unverified Report: Tree Branch Leaning on Feeder Line
description: Citizen post reporting heavy eucalyptus branch resting on overhead high-tension lines near railway colony.
verification_notes: Dispatched local line inspector for visual inspection.

title: Ganga Water Level Approaching Warning Mark at Assi
description: River waters submerged the lower 12 steps of Assi Ghat. Boat movement temporarily restricted by river police.
verification_notes: Navigational safety advisory broadcast over public address speakers.

title: Smoke Observed in Narrow Alleyway Godown
description: Textile packing material smoking in dense lane off Godowlia Chowk. Difficult vehicular access.
verification_notes: Portable motorcycle pump units mobilized due to lane width constraints.

title: Unverified: Damaged Signboard Dangling over Crossing
description: High winds twisted a commercial advertising iron frame hanging over pedestrian sidewalk.

title: Yamuna Floodplain Inundation Advisory at ITO Ring Road
description: River discharge entering low-lying floodplain agricultural nurseries and service lanes near ITO bridge.
location_name: ITO Ring Road Floodplain, New Delhi
verification_notes: Evacuation of low-lying cattle shelters and nurseries completed.

title: Waterlogging at Minto Road Underpass
description: Sudden intense downpour caused stormwater backup and 3 feet water accumulation under the railway bridge.
verification_notes: Traffic diverted. Automatic drainage pumps activated.

title: Unverified Report: Wire Sparks in Heritage Market
description: Overhead tangled utility wiring reported sparking near electrical junction box in wholesale lane.
